pdf_validation.source_limit: The SLEGS entry uses a same-work ChinaXiv machine-rendered full text with readable text and tables but no original figures; APS formal metadata was verified, but the APS version of record was not reviewed.

evidence_boundaries: The ICF experiment directly measures four VISAR shock trajectories; the approximately 13% M-band fraction and interface-pressure mechanism are one-dimensional model calibrations, not independent spectroscopy.

The SLEGS photoneutron cross section is experimental, while the gamma-strength models and inverse 208Bi(n,gamma) result are TALYS-dependent inferences; original figures were unavailable in the reviewed substitute full text.
The strong-field QED paper is a formal renormalization analysis, not a new observable-rate calculation or experiment.
The CTS work is validated on synthetic spectra only and remains candidate-model, stability-constraint and forward-model dependent.
No Multi1D, TALYS, loop-integral or Bayesian-sampling calculation was rerun locally.
